item.content:encoded: Downvote for now. The article throughout has a little trouble maintaining the clinical tone, and the dialogue seems forced. If the story slowly unfolded throughout the article, I think it would read much better.

item.title: Excellent job!
item.content:encoded: Thorough descriptions thst don't bog the article down; scientific without feeling antiseptic; besides, a benevolent but still dangerous god-skip currently getting along with the Foundation is something we don't see every day. Upvoted!
